claim.statement: V1.8 is validated for the implemented hook delivery surface: the compiled `eyes hook fetch` helper performs daemon IPC fetch, renders watcher-originated content, commits the cursor, and exits within a sub-second fixture bound; broader watcher/model inference latency is separately covered by V9.47's end-to-end budget.

evidence.summary: Integration test `hook_fetch_marks_watcher_origin_and_deduplicates_session` measures the compiled `eyes hook fetch` command and asserts elapsed time is under one second; the same source also records edit-to-hook visibility under 5s in end-to-end watch fixtures.

information_depth.rationale: The assertion exercises the exact hook helper path that harness adapters invoke, including daemon round trips and cursor commit.
